home.metaTitle: Oqoudi — Egyptian contracts and legal services
home.metaDescription: Order contract drafting, reviews or a legal consultation from lawyers in Egypt at a published price and timeline, and track it until delivery.
home.h1: Oqoudi — the Egyptian contracts and legal services platform
home.coverAlt: Oqoudi — the Egyptian contracts and legal services platform. Secure, precise documentation of your rights and business.
home.lead: Choose a service, fill in its form, pay securely, then follow the lawyer’s work step by step and receive your contract or answer in your account.

how.title: Four steps, each one visible to you

step1.title: Choose a service
step1.text: Browse services and read what each includes, its price and timeline.

step2.title: Fill in the form
step2.text: Every service has its own form, with document uploads.

step3.text: Pay securely and follow your order and the lawyer’s messages.

step4.text: Download the document or read the answer, accept it or ask for a revision, then rate the service.
